# Wireless equipment list

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-list.mjs from v1/rf-equipment.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

List version **2026-10-29** · 339 frequency bands and 22 notes from 33 brands · 141 manufacturer documents cited.

Wireless microphone, in-ear monitor (IEM) and WMAS frequency ranges as published by the manufacturers. Every range links to the manufacturer document it comes from. Used by KlarFunk and FreqSense for frequency coordination.

- Searchable version: https://square-smile.github.io/rf-equipment/
- Machine-readable: [v1/rf-equipment.json](https://square-smile.github.io/rf-equipment/v1/rf-equipment.json) (schema in [README.md](README.md))
- Found an error or missing gear? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Square-Smile/rf-equipment/issues/new) with a link to the manufacturer's own document (spec sheet, manual or frequency list). Dealer pages can't be used as sources.
- A range is what the hardware can tune. Whether you may use it depends on your country: check your regulator (in Germany, the BNetzA general assignment).

## Boss

- **WL-20 / WL-20L / WL-50:** BOSS WL guitar wireless: 2.4 GHz digital, auto-picks 1 of 14 channels — outside this UHF spectrum display. License-free; no fixed coordination. ([source](https://www.boss.info/us/products/wl-20_wl-20l/specifications/))

## Clear-Com

- **FreeSpeak II (1.9 GHz):** DECT wireless intercom. EU: 1880–1900 MHz (full band); US/Canada 1920–1930 MHz. Outside this UHF display; no conflict with mics, but keep antennas apart from mic receivers. ([source](https://clear-com.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SF/pages/158813296/Wireless+What+part+of+the+1.9+GHz+band+does+Freespeak+II+utilize))
- **FreeSpeak Edge (5 GHz):** 5 GHz wireless intercom, 20 MHz OFDM channels from 5180–5825 MHz (U-NII-1/2/2e/3; EU has 26 channels incl. DFS). Shares spectrum with 5 GHz Wi-Fi, not with UHF mics. ([source](https://clear-com.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/715685926/child/attachment/att715555134/download))

## DJI / Hollyland / Saramonic

- **Creator wireless mics:** DJI Mic / Mic 2 / Mic Mini, Hollyland Lark M1 / M2 / Max, Saramonic Blink500: 2.4 GHz (2400–2483.5 MHz) frequency hopping. DJI Mic 3 also uses 5.15–5.85 GHz. Outside this UHF spectrum display; license-free, no fixed coordination. ([source](https://www.dji.com/mic-2/specs))

## DPA

- **DPA:** DPA capsules use Lectrosonics (or other third-party) transmitter bodies. Select the matching transmitter brand above.

## Line 6

- **Line 6:** Line 6 Relay (G10/G10S/G30/G50/G55/G70/G75/G90) and XD-V series run at 2.4 GHz (ISM, not DECT) — outside this UHF spectrum display. License-free and frequency-agile; keep away from Wi-Fi access points. ([source](https://line6.com/data/6/0a020a3fbff95f43e6dba65f2/application/pdf/))

## LumenRadio

- **CRMX (wireless DMX):** Wireless DMX/RDM, 2402–2480 MHz ISM with adaptive frequency hopping. Competes with 2.4 GHz mics/Wi-Fi, not UHF. ([source](https://lumenradio.com/support-materials/crmx-slim-specifications))

- **U4 / U45:** Wireless IEM systems. U4 = 2.4 GHz (2400–2483.5 MHz), U45 = 5.8 GHz (carriers 5730–5844 MHz) digital — both outside this UHF spectrum display. License-free; coordinate separately.
